title: Tamal De Maicena
hookLine: Global-inspired tamal de maicena with 6 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Tamal De Maicena
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat the oven at 350F. In a non-stick medium pot, add the milk, butter, sugar, and vanilla; bring to a boil, and reduce heat to low. Incorporate {m53535_1}, {m53535_2}, {m53535_3}, and {m53535_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure milk first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: In a large bowl, add the eggs and the cornstarch and mix well. Slowly add 1 cup of the milk mixture, mixing constantly to temper the eggs. Keep adding more milk until the mixture is soft and has no lumps. Add the mixture to the pot SLOWLY and mix constantly using a wooden spoon. Incorporate {m53535_5} and {m53535_6} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Portion, Shape & Layer Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Keep cooking and mixing for a few more minutes until the mixture gets thick, you will know when it is ready when passing a spoon at the bottom of the pot creates a line that separates the mixture. Remove from heat and pour into the pyrex (no need to grease it ( I use an 11 by 8-inch pyrex).

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Cover with foil and cook for approximately 50 min. Remove the foil after 30 min of cooking to allow the top to get a light brown color.  Let it cool completely before serving.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
